method: Primary audit: 60 unique QA endpoints, 6 drawn randomly per original-kind x lexical-answer-type stratum; 30 shortened ScreenQA and 20 dev_answer simple random rows. Fixed seed 20261118. Nine extra draws cover missing price, duration/date, and phrase strata, seed 20261119; excluded from primary error-rate denominators. Answer types are lexical prospective strata, with semantic corrections noted per image.
ci_method: Wilson 95% intervals describe each audited primary sample. QA used disproportionate stratified sampling; its pooled Wilson interval is not a population interval. The separate population-weighted estimate uses N_h/2835 and an approximate stratified Wilson-MOVER interval; no finite-population correction. Single-auditor judgments, no model inference.
images_viewed: All 110 primary PNGs and 9 supplementary PNGs were viewed via view_image contact sheets, with original PNG follow-ups for qa19, qa49 and qa52. All prompts and rolling histories were read alongside the images. qa06 was also reviewed at original size.
